source.title: Frosty Favors
source.description: I'm the chief engineer, founder and head technician of the Deepsea Exploration and Liquefaction Technologies Alliance. I've nearly finished my latest experiment, and I need your help! I am working on a special device to geolocate resource-rich dimensions. To complete my construction, I need something back: a book of arcane formulas that I lent to an old colleague of mine, Numi, who continues her work in Winterspring. Retrieve the book for me and I'll reward you handsomely!
source.objective: Explain the book situation to Doctor Jurgens' colleague, Numi, in Winterspring.
source.completion: Sebastian needs it? He's a real piece of work. You're wasting your time asking for the book. I'm not giving it up or telling you where it is quite yet. But maybe we can make a deal.
